decision_rationale: The paper presents scCello as a pre-trained TFM and describes a masked gene expression prediction objective, indicating a genuinely generative pretraining model. It also states the model is a general-purpose foundation model, pre-trained on 22 million cells for downstream zero-shot and fine-tuning tasks.
